settings.question: 1. What type of jewelry do you offer?
settings.answer: We offer a beautiful collection of rings, earrings, chains, pendants, mangalsutra, nosepins, toe rings, bracelets, and men’s jewelry designed for daily wear, festive occasions, gifting, and special moments.

settings.question: 2. Is your jewelry suitable for daily wear?
settings.answer: Yes, many of our jewelry pieces are lightweight, comfortable, and perfect for everyday styling. We recommend keeping them away from water, perfume, and harsh chemicals to maintain their shine for longer.

settings.question: 3. How do I take care of my jewelry?
settings.answer: To keep your jewelry looking beautiful, store it in a dry place, avoid direct contact with water, perfume, lotions, and chemicals, and gently clean it with a soft cloth after use.

settings.question: 4. Do you offer jewelry for gifting?
settings.answer: Yes, our jewelry makes a perfect gift for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, festivals, and other special occasions. Every piece is carefully packed to make your gifting experience special.

settings.question: 5. How can I choose the right jewelry for myself?
settings.answer: You can choose jewelry based on the occasion, outfit, and your personal style. For daily wear, go for simple and lightweight designs. For weddings, parties, or festivals, choose statement pieces with elegant detailing.

settings.question: 6. Do you have jewelry for men?
settings.answer: Yes, we offer selected men’s jewelry such as rings, chains, pendants, and bracelets designed with a stylish and classic look.

settings.question: 7. Are the product images accurate?
settings.answer: We try our best to show clear and accurate product images. However, slight color differences may occur due to lighting, photography, or screen display settings.

settings.question: 8. How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery usually takes 4–7 business days depending on your location. Once your order is shipped, you will receive tracking details.

settings.question: 9. Can I track my order?
settings.answer: Yes, after your order is shipped, tracking details will be shared with you through email, SMS, or WhatsApp, depending on the contact details provided at checkout.

settings.question: 10. Do you offer returns or exchanges?
settings.answer: Returns or exchanges are available as per our store policy. Products must be unused, undamaged, and returned with original packaging. Please check our return policy page for complete details.

settings.question: 11. What should I do if I receive a damaged product?
settings.answer: If you receive a damaged or wrong product, please contact us within 24–48 hours of delivery with clear photos or videos of the product and packaging. Our team will assist you as soon as possible.

settings.question: 12. Is online payment safe?
settings.answer: Yes, our website uses secure payment methods to keep your transaction safe. You can shop confidently using available payment options at checkout.

settings.question: 13. Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: Cash on Delivery is available only if shown at checkout. Availability may depend on your location and order value.

settings.question: 14. Can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: You can request cancellation before the order is shipped. Once the order is dispatched, cancellation may not be possible.

settings.question: 15. How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: You can contact us through our contact page, email, phone, or WhatsApp. Our support team will be happy to help you with product queries, orders, shipping, returns, and exchanges.
